fields.caption: Carnival rides and monument, Yerevan
fields.alt: A colorful cartoon-themed carousel with animal-shaped seats in the foreground of an amusement park, with a tall Soviet-era statue on a pedestal rising above the trees against a bright blue sky with scattered clouds in Yerevan, Armenia.
fields.story: A summer afternoon in Yerevan blends Soviet-era grandeur with fairground color — a monument looming over spinning carousel animals, cartoon-themed rides, and a floating character balloon.

fields.caption: Surfers Riding the Eisbach Standing Wave, Munich
fields.alt: Wetsuit-clad surfers queue with colorful boards at the Eisbach's permanent standing wave in Munich's English Garden, spectators crowding the stone bridge above.
fields.story: The Eisbach river channel cuts through Munich's English Garden, generating a permanent standing wave that draws surfers year-round. Wetsuit-clad riders wait their turn while a crowd gathers on the bridge overhead, a ritual as familiar to Münchners as the beer gardens nearby.

fields.caption: Eternal Glory: Athens by Night
fields.alt: The illuminated Parthenon crowns the Acropolis atop its hillside, its ancient columns glowing warm against the night sky while the modern city spreads below in a tapestry of lights.
fields.story: The ancient Parthenon stands atop the Acropolis, its columns lit against the dark sky while the city below stretches in all directions, streets and modern buildings creating a sharp contrast between classical Greece and contemporary Athens. The warm artificial glow of the ruins sets them apart from the illuminated urban tapestry, a juxtaposition of millennia compressed into a single frame.

fields.caption: Mountain Gorilla at Volcanoes National Park
fields.alt: Close-up portrait of a mountain gorilla partially obscured by green leaves, its golden eyes gazing directly at the camera in Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park.
fields.story: In Rwanda's Volcanoes National Park, a mountain gorilla peers through dense forest foliage, its golden eyes carrying a calm intensity that makes the closeness feel earned rather than imposed — a rare moment of connection between human and primate.

fields.caption: Chimpanzee Sanctuary, Lake Victoria
fields.alt: A chimpanzee sits in a grassy enclosure behind a metal fence at a sanctuary on Lake Victoria, Uganda, looking directly at the camera with calm intensity.
fields.story: At a sanctuary on the shores of Lake Victoria, this individual meets the camera with a calm, direct gaze. The fence marks the boundary of protection — a symbol of conservation efforts keeping these primates safe in Uganda.

fields.caption: Zebras and Giraffe at Lake Nakuru
fields.alt: A group of zebras grazing on open grassland at Lake Nakuru, Kenya, with a giraffe towering above the acacia line in the background.
fields.story: On the shores of Lake Nakuru, zebras graze undisturbed while a giraffe towers above the acacia line — a quiet scene from one of Kenya's great wildlife sanctuaries.

fields.caption: Llama Among Ruins
fields.alt: A llama stands on grassy terrain beside ancient Incan stone walls, a lone tourist photographing the scene against a backdrop of towering mountains.
fields.story: A serene moment at ancient Incan ruins: a llama grazes in the foreground while a lone tourist captures the majestic mountain backdrop. The juxtaposition of living animal, dressed stone, and distant peaks collapses the distance between past and present.

fields.caption: Aurora Over Tromsø
fields.alt: A dark silhouette of a mountain peak set against a starry sky with vivid green auroras dancing above Tromsø, Norway.
fields.story: Standing over the fjords of northern Norway, a mountain ridge cuts a clean silhouette against the aurora borealis. The green curtains stretch across the sky above Tromsø, one of the world's prime aurora-watching destinations.

fields.caption: Leopard in the Canopy, Sabi Sands
fields.alt: A leopard's face peers directly at the camera from within tree branches in the Sabi Sands reserve, surrounded by lush greenery.
fields.story: A leopard peers from its perch in a Sabi Sands tree, its piercing gaze fixed on the camera. The scene captures the wild beauty and alertness of this predator in its natural habitat near Kruger.

fields.caption: Neon Dreams: A Night in the City
fields.alt: A nighttime street scene packed with bright neon signs, colorful billboards, and hanging red lanterns. Wires and pipes crisscross overhead while raindrops glisten on every surface.
fields.story: The vibrant streets of a bustling Japanese city come alive at night, illuminated by dazzling neon lights and traditional lanterns. Raindrops catch the electric glow as signs advertising local businesses jostle for space with red lanterns overhead.

fields.caption: Reaching for the Sky: Burj Khalifa
fields.alt: The Burj Khalifa's distinctive spire rises against a clear blue sky, framed by a lush palm tree with curved architectural elements in the foreground.
fields.story: The Burj Khalifa pierces a vibrant blue sky, its sleek spire a testament to human engineering and ambition. A palm tree and surrounding architecture frame the shot, capturing Dubai's characteristic layering of natural and built form.

fields.caption: The Atomium, Brussels
fields.alt: Close-up of the Atomium's metallic spheres and steel lattice framework against a bright blue sky with scattered clouds, green trees at the base.
fields.story: The Atomium rises against a clear blue sky, its interlocking spheres and steel lattice catching the light — a monument to postwar optimism rendered in industrial materials.

fields.caption: Paris from the Eiffel Tower
fields.alt: Aerial view of Paris from the Eiffel Tower, the iron latticework framing a vast cityscape of grid-like boulevards, parks, and the River Seine, with the Arc de Triomphe visible in the distance under a bright blue sky.
fields.story: Looking out from the Eiffel Tower, Paris unfolds in every direction: grid-like boulevards, the Arc de Triomphe, the green thread of parks, and the Seine cutting through it all. The tower's iron latticework frames the view, grounding the scale of the city below.

fields.caption: Sydney Opera House from the harbour
fields.alt: The Sydney Opera House with its distinctive white sail-like roof shells reflected in the calm harbour water, foam bubbles drifting across the surface with the city skyline visible in the distance.
fields.story: Shot from the water's edge, the Opera House sails mirror themselves in the still harbour. Foam bubbles drift across the surface of the bay, adding unexpected texture to the scene. The city skyline completes the backdrop.

fields.caption: Solitude on Ice
fields.alt: An enormous jagged iceberg rises from deep blue ocean water, surrounded by smaller ice floes under a dark sky.
fields.story: A massive iceberg floats on turbulent Antarctic waters, its rugged form standing in stark contrast to the dark churning sea. The scene evokes isolation and the raw beauty of nature's frozen landscapes.

fields.caption: Emperor Penguins on Antarctic Ice
fields.alt: Two emperor penguins stand side by side on snow-covered Antarctic ice, their black-and-white plumage and vivid yellow neck patches sharp against the vast white expanse.
fields.story: Two emperor penguins stand close together on the ice, their striking plumage contrasting with the pristine white around them. Their posture suggests a moment of quiet connection — resilience made visible in one of Earth's harshest places.

fields.caption: Iceberg Sentinel in Antarctica
fields.alt: A towering iceberg with a jagged peak rises from icy waters, framed by snow-covered mountains and glacial formations under a clear Antarctic sky.
fields.story: A majestic iceberg rises sharply from the icy waters, its jagged peak cutting through the crisp Antarctic air. Snow-capped mountains and glacial formations stretch behind it, the monochromatic palette underscoring the stark, otherworldly isolation of one of Earth's most remote and pristine wildernesses.

fields.caption: Lone Penguin on Antarctic Ice
fields.alt: A single emperor penguin stands on a vast expanse of white Antarctic terrain, its small dark form the only mark on an otherwise untouched snowfield, a winding trail of footprints stretching behind it.
fields.story: A lone penguin crosses the Antarctic ice, its small dark form the only mark on an otherwise untouched white expanse. The winding trail of footprints behind it tells of a solitary journey through one of Earth's most remote wilderness regions — the scale of the landscape underscoring the profound isolation of the continent.

fields.caption: Starry Night Over the Peaks
fields.alt: Mountainous landscape under a clear night sky filled with stars, pine trees lining the foreground and snow-capped peaks rising in the distance.
fields.story: The vast expanse of a starry sky dominates the frame above rugged mountain peaks and valleys, illuminated by soft moonlight, pine trees lining the foreground.

fields.caption: Golden Reflections on Salar de Uyuni
fields.alt: Bolivia's vast salt flat mirrors a sunset sky, golden light stretching across a perfectly still, flooded surface to a flat horizon.
fields.story: During the wet season, Salar de Uyuni becomes the world's largest natural mirror, the boundary between sky and earth dissolving into a single plane of gold.
